generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Financial bids of the technically qualified bidders only will be opened
Right of acceptance or rejection of any or all tenders with or without any reasons is reserved with the undersigned or any concerned higher officers of the Department
Conditional tender will not be Considered
Tender processing amount will not be refundable
The Photos and Video graphs should be taken before commencement, during execution and after completion of the work in presence of nodal officers

The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of each tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The department is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp portal

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD 300 LET 2006 Bangalore Dated 01/01/2007 and Government Letter No.PW 134 BMS 2007 Dated 27/7/2007 a sum amounting to 1 percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund
Executive Engineer has authority to accept or reject any tender without assigning reason
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number
Before tendering for the works the tenderer may inspect the site personally
The Employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The KPWD Code, KTTP Act/Rules ,Delegation of Powers and other Government Orders issued by the Government from time to time will apply
Additional GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for the delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately

Successful bidder submitting bids below the amount put to tender will be required to submit the difference amount in the form of FDR/TDR/DD/Pledge in the name of EE PRED Mandya within 20 days from the date of receiving the letter of acceptance as on additional security paid for unbalanced tender. Failing for which EMD will be forfeited and further action will be taken as per G O No FD PCL 2008 Bangalore Dated 14/10/2008
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents of KW-1 and as per tender notification
